Workflow.Name: Verify account address with Google Maps (sample)
Workflow.Description: Runs when the address of a account changes: checks it with Google Address Validation, writes the verified address back to the standard address columns, and adds a note with everything Google Maps returned. Part of the Google Maps sample app.
